Market today: The mood for tech and chips is cautious, driven by warnings of potential weakness in the chip sector. Rising oil prices add a layer of macro uncertainty, which can impact growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-53.92%) and SPAL (-33.48%) are leveraged ETFs with significant drawdowns and need immediate attention. SMH (-10.9%) is also a concern given the chip sector warning. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay or stop breaches. Also, monitor the broader chip sector for confirmation of the warned weakness.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and protect capital, especially in your leveraged and chip-heavy positions.
plays: Consider exiting SOXL given its 'SELL' status and significant -53.92% loss. Leveraged ETFs decay, and this drawdown is extreme.
Respect the stop on SPAL at 21.38. Its -33.48% loss on a leveraged ETF is substantial; be ready to act if the stop is hit.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The chip sector warning suggests caution on new long positions.
